BiblicalUsage: Jotbah is named once, in 2 Kings 21:19. In 2 Kings 21:19, the record says, "Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem."
TheologicalSignificance: Jotbah shows me God cares about the places as well as the people in them.
